security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code formatting, paths, and npm command examples. No prompt injection, credential access, data exfiltration, or malicious execution intent was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - `/app`: Next.js App Router pages and layouts.
- **Auth Integration**: Shared authentication state between Next.js and Docusaurus via cookies/sessi
- **Styling**: Global Tailwind styles in `app/globals.css`. Docusaurus has its own theme in `textboo
- **Hybrid App**: Combines a Next.js web app (marketing, auth, dashboard) with a Docusaurus document

content.value_statement: New contributors often lose time finding the right files and patterns. This skill summarizes the project stack, directories, and development commands.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the declared Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Docusaurus, Better Auth, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle stack.
Explains the documented purpose of top-level directories and selected auth files.
Identifies key architectural patterns for the hybrid web app and documentation site.
Lists local development commands for the root app, docs app, and combined workflow.
Helps contributors orient themselves before editing application or documentation files.
limitations: It reflects only the architecture notes in SKILL.md.
It does not inspect source code for current implementation drift.
It does not validate npm scripts or database configuration.
It does not replace security, performance, or dependency reviews.

use_cases.title: Onboard a New Developer
use_cases.description: Give a new contributor a quick map of the stack, folder roles, and local run commands.

use_cases.title: Plan a Feature Change
use_cases.description: Find likely areas for UI, auth, database, and documentation updates before starting implementation.

use_cases.title: Align Documentation Work
use_cases.description: Understand how the Docusaurus site fits beside the Next.js application and shared auth model.

prompt_templates.title: Get Oriented
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain this project's stack and directory layout in simple terms. Include the main apps and where common work should happen.

prompt_templates.title: Find Change Areas
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to update authentication and documentation. Based on the architecture notes, which directories and files should I inspect first?

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Onboarding Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create concise onboarding notes for a developer joining this project. Cover stack, structure, patterns, and local development commands.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Architecture Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze how a change to shared authentication could affect the Next.js app and Docusaurus site. List likely touchpoints and review risks.

output_examples.input: Where should I look for authentication work?
output_examples.output: Start with the auth components, shared library files, and the documented Better Auth client and server configuration files.

output_examples.input: How do the main app and docs app relate?
output_examples.output: The project combines a Next.js web app with a Docusaurus documentation site. Authentication state is shared through cookies or sessions.
The notes identify separate commands for the root app and docs app, plus one command that runs both together.

best_practices: Use the skill as a starting map before inspecting source files.
Verify architecture notes against the repository before major changes.
Pair the overview with focused searches in the relevant directories.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the notes prove the current code is synchronized.
Do not use the overview as a substitute for reading auth or database code.
Do not run development commands without checking project scripts first.

faq.question: What project type does this skill describe?
faq.answer: It describes a TypeScript project with a Next.js app and a Docusaurus documentation site.

faq.question: Does it include implementation details?
faq.answer: It includes high-level structure and named files, but it does not include full source code behavior.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it for onboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives these tools a concise architecture map before they inspect repository files.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It lists local npm development commands as documentation only.

faq.question: Does it cover security review?
faq.answer: No. It describes architecture and workflow, not vulnerability analysis.

faq.question: When should I verify the notes?
faq.answer: Verify them before changing core auth, database, routing, or documentation behavior.
